metadata.case_name: FANG CHO KWONG v. YAT KWONG AUTO PARTS LIMITED

plaintiff.occupation_before: The plaintiff works as a car repair technician in a garage as an employee of Kwai Keung Motors (“Kwai Keung”).
plaintiff.occupation_after: The plaintiff had continued working with his employer up until the present day.

source: I have considered the written submissions of both the plaintiff and the defendant and the cases therein and am of the opinion that as the injury involved a screw fixation surgery, even though there was no fracture, an award of HK$200,000 would be appropriate under PSLA.

treatments_received.treatment: Chinese bonesetter / Chinese medical practitioner treatment (Dr Cheng Kwok Wah)
source: The defendant opposes the HK$65,250 claimed for Chinese bonesetter fees incurred with Dr Cheng Kwok Wah.
I will therefore allow the 148 times of treatment at HK$250 each before the joint medical report, at a total of HK$37,000 should liability be established.
